shortDescription: Manage Oracle network Access Control Lists

options.name: host
options.description: ACL network host or wildcard pattern (not the database I(hostname)) Examples: '*.example.com', '10.0.0.0/24', 'db.internal'

options.name: hostname
options.description: Host name of the Oracle listener. The task key C(host) is reserved for the ACL network pattern; use I(hostname) for the database server (unlike most C(oracle_*) modules, C(host) is not an alias for I(hostname) here).

options.name: is_grant
options.description: Whether to grant (true) or deny (false) the privilege

options.name: lower_port
options.description: Lower bound of the port range

options.name: principal
options.description: Database user or role to grant or revoke access for

options.name: privilege
options.description: Network privilege to grant or deny

options.name: state
options.description: The intended state of the ACL entry

options.name: upper_port
options.description: Upper bound of the port range
